ns2:section.sectionText: This course supports LAS students engaged in full-time internship experiences during an academic semester. Students are provided with career development resources to help make the most of their hands-on experiences. Students set and monitor professional goals, engage in active reflection on progress, and consider next steps for academic and career futures. One virtual meeting is required at the beginning of the semester; remaining materials and activities are asynchronous via Canvas. S/U grading only. Course may be repeated, but not in consecutive semesters. Consent of course instructor required. Only students in the College of LAS will be allowed to enroll.
